note: Alberta Parks campground about 40 km south of Robb on Hwy 40, run by West Fraser and the Fox Creek Development Association: one loop of well-spaced sites in the trees near the Lovett River, formerly a group campground. Free firewood. Fishing for rainbow trout, whitefish and bull trout, canoeing, and unmaintained trails. --Claude

WATERFRONT (stored riverview, checked hard): recommend NOT WATERFRONT. Esri imagery (2024-07-12): the single loop sits in continuous forest; its south side is ~40-50 m from the Lovett River's channel with unbroken trees between, and the rest of the loop is 80-150 m back. West Fraser says 'located adjacent to the Lovett River' (the campground, not a site). No site with a view was placed.

ACCESS (not a drop): West Fraser's directions route through Hinton via Robb Road: 'Robb road is an active logging/hauling road. Drive with extreme caution.' The other route it gives is paved Hwy 47/40 from Edson, and the campground is on Hwy 40 itself; no 4WD, clearance or RV warning. The old note's 'access road normally passable by 2WD' has no source and was removed.
